scoring_justification: T1 (recompute) infeasible because the checker cannot re-run the stochastic nucleation-and-growth simulator; T0 result-level comparison against paper‑reported TEM median grain areas (Table I) is acceptable per D4.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference median grain areas for the three ramp rates (380, 7.5, 0.17 °C/min)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, column ‘From TEM’ — directly transcribed from the published article.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted the three values 497, 918, 1552 (nm²) from the paper’s data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own experimental values, not invented; they are the ground truth for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Average median grain area for three temperature ramp rates, computed from stochastic nucleation-and-growth simulations. The hidden checker compares these against paper-reported experimental values (TEM) using relative error thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The simulation uses the physical parameters, geometry, and nucleation model described in the steps; no additional calibration or parameter fitting is required.

steps.description: Score the reported average median grain areas for the three ramp rates against the paper’s TEM values. Each value is scored based on relative error, then the three scores are averaged.
